title: test(docs-validator): harden doctrine-adoption guardrail coverage (T224)
body:
## Summary T224's guardrail rule already shipped in `a667d44`: `docsValidator` requires the `Initialize Or Repair A Doctrine Pack For An Established Workspace` heading plus the `Ralphdex: Initialize Doctrine Pack` label and `ralphCodex.initializeDoctrinePack` id in `docs/workflows.md`. The one gap vs. the acceptance wording — *"fail when the heading **or** the command reference is removed"* — is that the existing regression drops the whole section at once, so it never proves the **required-fragment** rule fires *independently* of the heading rule. This adds that missing case (test-only — no validator/runtime change): ``` seedValidRepository → keep the doctrine heading, replace only "2. Run `Ralphdex: Initialize Doctrine Pack` (`ralphCodex.initializeDoctrinePack`)." with a generic line → validateRepositoryDocs assert: missing_heading(doctrine) == false // heading retained missing_fragment(label) && (id) == true // refs dropped ``` It reads/mutates the seeded fixture rather than duplicating the large workflows.md fixture, so it won't drift. `npm run validate` passes (1436 tests, 0 fail); `npm run check:docs` passes. With this, all four T224 acceptance items are satisfied (rule + label/id references + independent heading-vs-fragment regression coverage + green gate), so T224 can be closed. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/b9797888ec9a41c6a362ed704c15d0a3 Requested by: @S0l0m0n8und9

Greptile Summary

 This PR adds a single focused regression test to `docsValidator.test.ts` that proves the `missing_fragment` guardrail for the doctrine-adoption command references fires **independently** of the `missing_heading` guardrail — the gap identified in T224. - The test seeds a valid repository, reads back the seeded `docs/workflows.md`, replaces only the numbered-list line containing `Ralphdex: Initialize Doctrine Pack` and `ralphCodex.initializeDoctrinePack` with a generic line (leaving the heading intact), then asserts that no `missing_heading` issue is raised while both `missing_fragment` issues are raised. - An `assert.notEqual(stripped, seeded, …)` guard before the write ensures the fixture actually contains the expected line, so any future drift in `seedValidRepository` surfaces immediately with a descriptive message rather than a silent false-positive.

Confidence Score: 5/5

 This PR is safe to merge. It adds a test-only change with no impact on the validator implementation or any runtime path. The new test correctly targets the seeded fixture line matching what seedValidRepository writes. The assert.notEqual guard prevents silent false-positives if the fixture drifts. Both fragment assertions correspond exactly to the two requiredFragments entries in DOC_RULES for docs/workflows.md, and both fragments appear only on the one replaced line in the seeded file. No files require special attention.

Important Files Changed

 | Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | test/docsValidator.test.ts | Adds one new regression test that mutates the seeded workflows.md fixture (keeping the doctrine heading, stripping only the command label and id) and asserts the heading rule stays silent while both fragment rules fire independently. Logic, guard check, and assertions are all correct. |

Flowchart

 ```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart TD A[seedValidRepository] --> B[Read seeded docs/workflows.md] B --> C{Contains doctrine command line?} C -->|Yes - assert.notEqual passes| D[Replace step 2 with generic text] C -->|No - assert.notEqual fails| E[Test fails with descriptive message] D --> F[Write stripped workflows.md] F --> G[validateRepositoryDocs] G --> H{missing_heading for doctrine section?} H -->|Heading still present: false| I[Assert heading NOT fired] G --> J{missing_fragment for label?} J -->|Fragment gone: true| K[Assert label fragment fired] G --> L{missing_fragment for id?} L -->|Fragment gone: true| M[Assert id fragment fired] ```
